title: Parsing one aligned bit pair
statement: Let $x=\mathrm{pre}\,b\,d\,\mathrm{rest}$ be a Boolean word, where $b,d$ are bits, and let $c$ be any configuration of a Boolean finite Turing machine $M$ and $r$ a natural number. Starting in the parser state at position $|\mathrm{pre}|$, after two steps the augmented machine is in the parser state at position $|\mathrm{pre}|+2$ if $b=d$; if $b\ne d$ and $b=1$, it is halted at position $|\mathrm{pre}|+1$ with output $[0]$; and if $b\ne d$ and $b=0$, it is in state $3$ at position $|\mathrm{pre}|+2$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a Boolean finite Turing machine
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on Boolean input $x$
